_readme: The books read in full for the archive — the integrated half of pipeline/book_queue/state.json (31 of 42; the 11 skipped are absent). Hand-curated on 17 October 2026 from the '*Source:' header of each entries/book_takeaways/<id>.md, which is the most carefully checked bibliographic record the project holds; where that header qualifies a value (an author 'to confirm', two imprint years on one page) the qualifier is carried in `note` rather than resolved (RULE 2). `id` is the book-queue id and joins to state.json and the takeaways file; `slug` is the public route, /source/<slug>. `match` is a distinctive lowercased substring that, found in a bibliography line, means that line cites this book — the same convention and the same caution as source-works.json, and sourceLibrary.test.ts checks every hit by hand-listed expectation. `workSlug` names the source-works.json entry when the archive already groups this book's citations. `pages` is the scan's page count, not the printed extent. `original` is the language the work was written in; `read` is the language of the copy that was read.
